items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember? You know, Pete Lawless, they come around to the cabaret...

ctx.x: Do you remember? You know, Pete Lawless, they come around to the cabaret to get the... Mm-hmm. For them to sign up and all that. And so that's when they decided to go away. Yeah.
That was my... Well, what we wanted to say there in answer to Mr. Russell's question is that each theater had their own piano player and drummer. Yes. Some just a piano player.
